_about: Canned output of the Cluster Detection Agent for the dashboard demo. Hantavirus row is the canonical Scenario D cluster from plan/04-data-flows.md. Severity ladder: info | watch | alert | urgent.

clusters.title: 4 hantavirus-compatible obs / Coconino County / 10 d
clusters.summary: Cluster Detection Agent flagged 4 hantavirus-compatible CHW check-ins in Coconino County over the last 10 days, mostly in tribal communities. Co-located WHISPers prairie-dog mortality event (event 9000006) within 25 km. Matches the Scenario D walkthrough.
clusters.observation_query:
SELECT n.node_id, n.label, p.value_text AS reported_at
FROM   kg.node n
JOIN   kg.property p ON p.node_id = n.node_id AND p.key = 'reported_at'
WHERE  n.node_type = 'observation'
  AND  n.node_id IN (
    SELECT subject_id FROM kg.edge
    WHERE  predicate = 'memberOf'
      AND  object_id  = 'cluster.coconino_hantavirus_2026w19'
  )
ORDER BY p.value_text DESC;

clusters.title: WNV vector-index threshold exceeded in 4 Maricopa ZCTAs
clusters.summary: VectorSurv pool MIR > 8 per 1000 in Phoenix-metro ZCTAs 85003, 85008, 85019, 85033 across week 19. Same signal that flipped Scenario B's clinician-alert-WNV triage class.
clusters.observation_query:
SELECT zcta, mir_per_1000, week
FROM   vector_index.wnv
WHERE  county = 'Maricopa' AND week >= '2026-W18'
ORDER BY mir_per_1000 DESC;

clusters.title: 5 unsheltered heat-exhaustion check-ins / ZCTA 85003 / 2 h
clusters.summary: Five CHW heat check-ins from downtown Phoenix (ZCTA 85003) within a two-hour window crossed the Phase-1 heat-emergency threshold. Triggers a county heat-emergency alert to MCDPH per plan/05-roadmap.md Phase 1 success criterion.
clusters.observation_query:
SELECT n.node_id, p_zcta.value_text AS zcta, p_dt.value_text AS reported_at
FROM   kg.node n
JOIN   kg.property p_zcta ON p_zcta.node_id = n.node_id AND p_zcta.key = 'zcta'
JOIN   kg.property p_dt   ON p_dt.node_id   = n.node_id AND p_dt.key   = 'reported_at'
WHERE  n.node_type = 'observation'
  AND  p_zcta.value_text = '85003'
  AND  CAST(p_dt.value_text AS TIMESTAMP) >= NOW() - INTERVAL '2 HOURS'
ORDER BY p_dt.value_text DESC;

clusters.title: Plague-positive prairie-dog die-off / Flagstaff area
clusters.summary: WHISPers event 9000006 (Yersinia pestis, Gunnison's prairie dog) extended into week 18. Grand Canyon NPS notified; co-flag with Coconino HHS for human-risk messaging.
clusters.observation_query: SELECT * FROM kg.v_whispers_events WHERE county='Coconino' AND diagnosis ILIKE '%pestis%';

clusters.title: WNV-positive corvid die-off / Tucson
clusters.summary: iNaturalist citizen-science reports of dead American crows in Tucson during week 17 cross-reference with WHISPers event 9000007. Pima County Health notified; lab confirmation pending.
clusters.observation_query: SELECT * FROM kg.v_whispers_events WHERE county='Pima' AND diagnosis ILIKE '%West Nile%';

clusters.title: HPAI wild-waterfowl detections / Maricopa + Yuma wetlands
clusters.summary: Pacific Flyway HPAI H5N1 surveillance positives along the lower Gila and Colorado rivers. Wildlife Health Program coordinating with USDA APHIS.
clusters.observation_query: SELECT * FROM kg.v_whispers_events WHERE diagnosis ILIKE '%HPAI%' OR diagnosis ILIKE '%H5N1%';

clusters.title: EHDV in mule deer / Patagonia corridor
clusters.summary: Epizootic hemorrhagic disease virus in Odocoileus hemionus near Patagonia; AZGFD Wildlife Health Program surveillance row.
clusters.observation_query: SELECT * FROM kg.v_whispers_events WHERE county='Santa Cruz' AND diagnosis ILIKE '%EHDV%';

clusters.title: Grand Canyon NPS visitor heat-illness uptick
clusters.summary: Three heat-stroke transports from South Rim trailheads in 48 hours; NPS-coordinated CHW outreach being scaled up. Coconino HHS standing co-lead.
clusters.observation_query:
SELECT n.node_id, p.value_text AS reported_at
FROM   kg.node n
JOIN   kg.property p ON p.node_id = n.node_id AND p.key = 'reported_at'
WHERE  n.node_type = 'observation'
  AND  n.node_id IN (
    SELECT subject_id FROM kg.edge
    WHERE  predicate = 'occurredIn'
      AND  object_id  = 'park.grand_canyon_south_rim'
  );
